summary.en:
Kogoro and Conan happen to pass by two police officers, Takagi and Chiba, investigating the scene of a murder.

The reason Takagi and Chiba know the exact time of the crime is because the photographer, Takeru Motomiya, happened to capture the moment when the victim was struck, and took a picture from it.

locations: Tea room of Hotel O'Brien's garden
suspects: Toshiki Morita, Masato Kijima, Takeru Motomiya and Hideaki Okawa
locationsZh: 奥布莱恩酒店花园茶室
